definition: headwear that protects the head from bad weather
description: A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.

de.answer: Er gießt Wasser auf die Steine.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está echando agua sobre las piedras.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il verse de l'eau sur les pierres.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
